title: "Day 3 — Spatial Analysis & Statistical Modelling"

## Where the day goes

Two ways of asking "what explains this?" — a model and a map. Both on survey data
with weights, both interpreted for a reader who does not know what a coefficient is.

## Sessions

| Time | Session | Material |
|---|---|---|
| 09:30–11:15 | **Modelling for evidence** — linear and logistic; `svyglm`; odds ratios, CIs, diagnostics | [`scripts/linear-regression.R`](scripts/linear-regression.R) · [`scripts/car-price-regression.R`](scripts/car-price-regression.R) · [`01-dhs-model-datasets.qmd`](01-dhs-model-datasets.qmd) |
| 11:30–13:00 | **Spatial data & mapping — WFP food prices** — `sf`, joins to boundaries, `tmap` choropleths | [`scripts/pakistan-district-choropleth.R`](scripts/pakistan-district-choropleth.R) |
| 14:00–15:15 | **Interactive maps** — `leaflet` popups and layers, `mapview` for exploration | [`scripts/pakistan-maps-geoboundaries.R`](scripts/pakistan-maps-geoboundaries.R) |
| 15:30–16:30 | **Applied policy modelling with AI support** — affordability from price and wage series; debugging CRS and join errors | [`scripts/survey-health-indicators.R`](scripts/survey-health-indicators.R) · [AI prompt library](../../reference/ai-prompts/index.qmd) |

::: {.callout-warning}
## The two errors that eat this day
A join key whose spelling differs between the indicator file and the shapefile, and a
CRS mismatch. Check `anti_join()` counts and `st_crs()` **before** you blame the map.
:::

## By 16:30 you should be able to

- fit a survey-weighted model and say what one coefficient means in a sentence
- join an indicator to district boundaries and know how many rows failed to match
- produce a print-ready choropleth and an interactive map of the same indicator
